title: Tech Note: Syntaxia - A Database of 4D Language Components
author: Bart Scott

historical_commentary.text: This note documents the Syntaxia database, a comprehensive reference tool cataloging all 500+ commands, constants, and plug-in commands in 4D v6 with their syntax, shortcuts, and command numbers. While the specific database is long obsolete — replaced by 4D's built-in documentation, the Explorer, and online language references — the note provides a fascinating snapshot of the 4D language ecosystem circa 1999 and the creative tools developers built to manage the platform's growing complexity.
related_updates: 4D's built-in Explorer and online documentation have replaced the need for separate language reference databases
The 4D language has grown from ~500 commands to well over 1,500 built-in commands
Several plug-ins referenced (4D Calc, 4D Chart, 4D Draw) have been discontinued
